name: io.github.Servosity/sophos-central-mcp
title: Sophos Central MCP
description: The Sophos Central partner, organization and tenant APIs, routed to the right tenant and region

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of a Sophos Central API credential (Partner Dashboard > Settings & Policies > API Credentials, or Global Settings > API Credentials Management).

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that API credential. Sophos shows it only once, when the credential is created.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. With a partner or organization credential, the customer tenant ID that tenant-scoped tools act on. Leave blank to let the fleet tools walk every customer; tools that take a tenant argument can still pick one per call.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank: requests go to https://api.central.sophos.com and each tenant's regional host is found automatically.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the scope Sophos Central documents (token).

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every non-GET call and hide the sync and export tools. It does not replace giving the API credential a read-only role.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Sophos Central. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
